title: Machine learning-guided amidase engineering improves enantioselectivity
summary: Random-forest models using chemistry and geometry descriptors were trained on 240 prior amidase datasets and used to guide substrate and variant selection. The primary article reports that variant I198F/W328F achieved an enantioselectivity E-value of 303.5, compared with 5.7 for wild type, for the reported substrate assay. Most experimental substrate predictions agreed, with identified exceptions. This bounded laboratory result does not establish broad performance across substrates or industrial application.
